description: The chart illustrates the number of tasks associated with each language family in the context of morphosyntactic probing, with one horizontal bar per family. The category axis is the vertical axis, listing language families from top to bottom as IE-Slavic, IE-Romance, IE-Germanic, Uralic, IE-Baltic, IE-other, IE-Indic, Semitic, Turkic, and Basque. The value axis is the horizontal axis labeled “# tasks,” shown on a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80 with regularly spaced tick marks every 10 units. Bars are color-coded distinctly by category without a legend: IE-Slavic is a light blue bar reaching just under 80 (approximately 79); IE-Romance is a darker blue bar reaching just under 50 (about 47); IE-Germanic is light green at roughly 44; Uralic is green at about 20; IE-Baltic is light pink at about 17; IE-other is red at about 15; IE-Indic is tan at about 10; Semitic is orange at about 8; Turkic is light lavender at about 4; and Basque is dark purple at about 3. The bars appear arranged in descending order by task count from top (largest) to bottom (smallest), and there are no additional annotations or special visual emphasis beyond the differing bar colors.
